title: Recover sign-out after a persisted worker interruption
description: One commander uses two independent authenticated devices. Saved identity survives account-wide sign-out; an unsaved draft remains while confirmation is cancelled. Both devices show the acknowledged session end before fresh sign-in recovers the saved identity.

steps.description: Prepare two independent authenticated devices through ordinary sign-in and identity-save controls; the second device holds an unsaved draft.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: The signed-in entry provides device management while the other device retains its draft.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.

steps.acknowledgement: The device panel asks for Google confirmation.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.

steps.description: Close the panel and return focus to its opening control.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.

steps.description: Reopen devices and cancel the Google confirmation popup. No session has ended.
steps.acknowledgement: The uncertain completion alert receives focus.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.
The second device still holds its unsent draft.

steps.description: Intercept the actual authenticated callable, invoke its real service transaction, stop after its fence persists and expire only the stopped worker lease. No identity, command or session result is fabricated.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Confirm with Google; the worker stops after recording the session fence, leaving completion uncertain.
steps.acknowledgement: Completion remains uncertain after the real persisted fence.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.

steps.description: Remove the one-request transport interruption so normal callable recovery can claim the expired lease.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Reload restores the unfinished sign-out panel and its confirmation action.
steps.acknowledgement: The persisted recovery panel is ready for confirmation.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.

steps.description: Confirm account-wide sign-out. Both devices acknowledge the ended session and discard their editors.
steps.acknowledgement: Both devices acknowledge session end and focus Play.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.

steps.description: Firebase auth_time uses whole seconds. Wait until a fresh sign-in is strictly after the acknowledged revocation cutoff; this changes no service clock or state.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Sign in again and recover the saved identity, not the other device’s discarded draft.
steps.acknowledgement: The saved commander identity is restored.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.
Recovered identity does not claim a new save from the ended session.

steps.description: Reload and reopen identity without saving another revision.
steps.acknowledgement: The same saved identity survives reload.
verifications: Saved identity has one revision, one version and one acknowledged receipt.
